nodes.name: Iron foam cleaning
nodes.procedure: The oxidation layer on the surface of iron foam was removed by sonicated in 6.0 M HCl.

nodes.name: Ni/IF electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The electrodeposition is carried out in a standard three electrode electrochemical cell (IF, working electrode; carbon electrode, counter electrode; Ag/AgCl, reference electrode). The electrolyte aqueous consists of 5.5 mmol NiSO4·6H2O and 0.35 mg (NH4)2SO4 in 100 mL deionized water. Electrodeposition is carried by a constant current at cathodic current density of 200 mA cm^-2 for 900 s, the product was denoted as Ni/IF.
nodes.source_text: The electrolyte aqueous consists of 5.5 mmol NiSO4·6H2O and 0.35 mg (NH4)2SO4 in 100 mL deionized water. Electrodeposition is carried by a constant current at cathodic current density of 200 mA cm^-2 for 900 s

nodes.name: NiM/IF electrodeposition (M=Fe,Co,Cu,Mo,Zn)
nodes.procedure: NiM/IF (M= Fe, Co, Cu, Mo, Zn) was synthesized according to the same procedure with 5.5-x mmol NiSO4·6H2O, x (x = 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3) mmol M sulphate, 0.35 mg (NH4)2SO4 in 100 mL deionized water, and constant current electrodeposition at cathodic current density of 200 mA cm^-2 for 900 s.
nodes.source_text: NiM/IF (M= Fe, Co, Cu, Mo, Zn) was synthesized according to the same procedure with 5.5-x mmol NiSO4·6H2O, x mmol M sulphate...

nodes.name: O-NiM/IF CV oxidation
nodes.procedure: O-NiM/IF was synthesized by CV electrochemical oxidation. CV oxidation with scan rate of 5 mV·s^-1 in the potential range from 0 to 0.7 V vs. Ag/AgCl are executed. CV circle is set to 5, 10, 15, 20 to realize different O content in O-NiM/IF.

nodes.description: General alkaline HER performance testing for all NiM/IF catalysts (Ni/IF, NiFe/IF, NiCo/IF, NiCu/IF, NiMo/IF, NiZn/IF)
nodes.source_text: All electrochemical tests were carried out by using CHI760e electrochemical workstation. The Ag/AgCl (saturated KCl solution) was used as the reference electrode, carbon electrode was served as the counter electrode, and the synthesized NiM was utilized as working electrode. The aqueous electrolyte is 1 M KOH solution. The linear sweep voltammograms (LSV) was measured from -1.0 to -1.5 V vs. Ag/AgCl, and a slow scan rate of 2 mV/s is applied.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of the NiCux electrocatalysts show lattice constant increases with increased Cu content; phase-separated Cu and Ni metal phases form when Cu:Ni ratio > 3.5.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S5. XRD patterns of the NiCux electrocatalysts. Obviously, the lattice constant increases with the increased content of Cu. Meanwhile, phase-separated Cu and Ni metal phases were formed when the ratio of Cu to Ni is too high (> 3.5).

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show Ni grain size decreases significantly with Cu introduction, favoring larger specific surface area and more active sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S15. SEM images for (a) Ni and (b) NiCu. The grain size of Ni is decreased significantly with the introduction of Cu, the smaller grain size is in favor of the larger specific surface area to expose more active sites.
